description: This file contains classes and functions for managing web driver interactions, including Selenium and Playwright, for taking screenshots and handling browser automation within the Superset project. It includes driver creation, error handling, and support for large dashboards with tiled screenshots.

classes.name: WebDriverProxy
classes.description: Abstract base class for web driver implementations, defining the interface for taking screenshots.

classes.name: WebDriverPlaywright
classes.description: Implementation of WebDriverProxy using Playwright for browser automation and screenshot capture.

classes.name: WebDriverSelenium
classes.description: Implementation of WebDriverProxy using Selenium WebDriver for browser automation and screenshot capture.

methods.name: check_playwright_availability
methods.description: Checks if Playwright is installed and can launch a browser.

methods.name: validate_webdriver_config
methods.description: Validates and reports the status of webdriver dependencies and feature flags.

methods.name: auth
methods.description: Authenticates a user session with the browser context or WebDriver.

methods.name: find_unexpected_errors
methods.description: Detects unexpected error messages in the page or driver and optionally updates the page with error info.

methods.name: get_screenshot
methods.description: Main method to capture a screenshot of a URL, waiting for page elements and handling errors.
